question: Does long-run insurgent viability exhibit an interior optimum in mobilization tempo because very slow recruitment under-replaces attrition while fast recruitment exhausts organizational capital?
analysis: Do not assume monotonicity. Identify whether any interior recruitment cell strictly exceeds both zero/lowest recruitment and 0.5x on joint viability.
Joint viability requires organization active, rooted membership >0, and operational fielded force >0 at day360.
Report capital runway and cumulative recruitment so survival through inactivity can be distinguished from sustainable regeneration.
If no interior maximum appears, record monotonic low-tempo advantage rather than forcing an optimum claim.
